Overheads, like data, transport and tool: Ọnụ ego, dị ka data, ụgbọ njem na ngwaọrụ, na 10%: 1,970 naira. Ọnụ ya zuru ezu bụ narị naira iri abụọ na otu na narị isii na iri asaa.
A 30% markup adds 6,501 naira, and she r: Nrịbama 30% gbakwụnye naịra 6,501, wee gbakọọ ọnụ ahịa ya na narị naira iri abụọ na asatọ na narị ise.
Markup is profit on cost. Margin is prof: Markup bụ uru na ọnụ ahịa. Oke bụ uru na ọnụahịa. Uru ya bụ naanị ihe dịka 24% nke ọnụahịa ahụ. Ịgbagwojuru anya abụọ bụ ụzọ a na-ahụkarị maka ọnụ ala.

Use payment links or POS records: Jiri njikọ ịkwụ ụgwọ ma ọ bụ ndekọ POS
Take about half as deposit: Were ihe dị ka ọkara dị ka nkwụnye ego
Trust an SMS or screenshot alone: Tụkwasị SMS ma ọ bụ nseta ihuenyo naanị
Cut price below your full cost: Wepụ ọnụ ahịa n'okpuru ọnụ ahịa gị zuru oke
Confirm the money has actually arrived i: Gosi na ego a abanyela n'ụlọ akụ ma ọ bụ ngwa obere akpa gị. Njikọ ịkwụ ụgwọ na ịkwụ ụgwọ POS na-enye gị ndekọ. Maka ọrụ omenala, were nkwụnye ego, mgbe mgbe ọkara, tupu ịzụrụ ihe. Kechie iberibe ndị na-emebi emebi ma mejupụta oghere ọ bụla n'ime igbe ahụ.
Never release goods because of an SMS or: Ahapụla ngwa ahịa n'ihi SMS ma ọ bụ nseta ihuenyo. A na-ama ọkwa adịgboroja. Kpachara anya maka ndị na-azụ ahịa na-akwụ ụgwọ karịa ma rịọ maka nkwụghachi. Ya adịkwala mgbe ebilata ọnụ ahịa gị n'okpuru ọnụ ahịa gị zuru oke.
Odd numbers, often three: Ọnụọgụ dị iche iche, ọtụtụ mgbe atọ
High, medium and low heights: Elu, ọkara na ala dị elu
A vignette is a small styled group on a: Vignette bụ obere ụdị nke dị na shelf ma ọ bụ tebụl dị n'akụkụ. Otu ihe dị iche iche na ọnụọgụ dị iche, na-agbanwe ịdị elu, gwakọta textures dị ka ciment dị nro na macramé dị nro, ma kwugharịa otu agba na opekata mpe ebe atọ.
For example, Zainab in Abuja styles a sh: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Zainab nọ n'Abuja na-eji mpempe nke ya na-eme ụlọ dị mkpụmkpụ. Ngwaahịa, oge nhazi na njem na-abịa 152,500 naira. Ọ na-enye 150,000 ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere ike iji foto ndị dị na Pọtụfoliyo ya.
She takes a 75,000 naira deposit to star: Ọ na-ewe ego nkwụnye ego puku naira iri asaa na ise ka ọ malite. Ọ na-enweta ikike ederede maka foto, wee hapụ nọmba ụlọ na foto ezinụlọ iji chebe nzuzo onye ahịa.
High value, modest effort projects: Ọnụ ahịa dị elu, ọrụ mbọ dị obere
Materials + labour + overheads + profit: Akụrụngwa + ọrụ + ihe karịrị ego + uru
Style in odd numbers and varied heights: Ụdị n'ọnụọgụ dị iche na ịdị elu dị iche iche
To remember. Choose projects with high v: Icheta. Họrọ oru ngo nwere oke uru na mbọ dị ala. Agbala agba ochie kpọrọ nkụ. Wulite ọnụ ahịa ọ bụla site na akụrụngwa, ọrụ, oke ego na uru. Kwenye ego n'ime ngwa nke gị. Na gosi iberibe gị ndị a haziri n'ime ezigbo ụlọ.
Now build an upcycling project file with: Ugbu a wulite faịlụ ọrụ cycling nke nwere foto mbụ na mgbe emechara, mpempe ọnụahịa maka ngwaahịa atọ, yana vignette nwere ụdị ngwugwu nwere onyinye ngwungwu ederede.
